title: Diabetes 130-US Hospitals 1999-2008 (UCI 296)
subtitle: Unmodified UCI copy for 30-day readmission prediction
description: Unmodified copy of the UCI Machine Learning Repository dataset 296, 'Diabetes 130-US Hospitals for Years 1999-2008' (https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/296), licensed CC BY 4.0. 101,766 inpatient encounters, 50 columns. Files: diabetic_data.csv (encounters), IDS_mapping.csv (ID lookup for admission type, discharge disposition, admission source). Source study: B. Strack et al., 'Impact of HbA1c Measurement on Hospital Readmission Rates: Analysis of 70,000 Clinical Database Patient Records,' BioMed Research International, 2014, doi:10.1155/2014/781670. Note: missing values are encoded as '?'; the string 'None' in A1Cresult and max_glu_serum means 'test not performed' and is a valid category.
